title: Enter gets accounts and API keys
summary:
Enter gained GitHub sign-in, self-service API keys and a dashboard balance view, with generation tracking wired up behind them.

Added GitHub sign-in and a dashboard where signed-in users can create, list and delete API keys.

The dashboard also shows a signed-in user's Polar customer meter balance.

The same PR added API proxy routes and generation-event handling, along with the database, observability and tests behind the new flows.

daily.title: Manage keys in Enter
daily.text: Sign in with GitHub to create, view and delete your API keys from the Enter dashboard. [Open API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
